enabled.description: Enable passwdqc enforcement. If false, only logs weak passwords without blocking them.

min_length.description: Minimum lengths for passwords, encoded as 'disabled:class:min:length'. Format: disabled (off), weak (24 chars), medium (11), strong (8), extra (7). Example: 'disabled,24,11,8,7'

max_length.description: Maximum password length in characters. Set to 0 for no upper limit.

min_passphrase_length.description: Minimum number of words in a passphrase. 0 = no passphrase support.

min_match_length.description: Minimum length of substrings that must match (case-insensitive) to reject password.

similar.description: Whether to deny passwords similar to the old one. Values: 'deny', 'allow'.

min_random_length.description: Minimum length of randomly generated passwords.

enforce_for.description: Which users to enforce password checking on. Values: 'everyone', 'admin', 'nonroot'.

retry_limit.description: Maximum number of authentication attempts allowed before locking. 0 = no limit.

wordlist_path.description: Path to wordlist for additional rejection rules. Set to 'none' to disable.

reject_user_name.description: Reject passwords containing the user's login name or gecos (full name) fields. (Mapped via enforce=everyone; handled internally by passwdqc when enforced for non-root users.)

unique_chars.description: Minimum number of unique characters required in the password. 0 = no requirement.

remember_count.description: Number of previous passwords to remember for history enforcement. Set to 0 to disable history.

old_passwords_path.description: Path to file storing hashed password history.

extra_options.description: Additional key=value pairs for advanced or optional passwdqc settings. (Note: Values are applied as-is and appended to config; not used in template above, which uses only standard keys.)
